edge_threshold.method: Smallest claimed edge t (0-30% in 1% steps) such that past bets claiming t to t+5% returned more than 0 per unit staked at the 95% lower bound, and so did every higher band with at least 30 bets; ranges resample whole matches; found on development seasons, then checked on the latest season (bets at t and up must have returned more than 0).
edge_threshold.note: No minimum edge works. At every claimed edge from 0% to 30%, the 746 past player bets lost money or could plausibly have lost it, so no edge the model claims is large enough to trust. The best band was 10%-15%: 75 bets returned +97.2% a bet (range -9.3% to +229.9%).
